column4:
Navigate ZEEKR Pilot (NZP) is available on controlled-access urban expressways
and highways covered by HD maps (where permitted by applicable laws and regulations
and enabled by ZEEKR). Turn it on by pushing the gear lever down twice in a row.
It assists the driver in following the set navigation route, automatically adjusts
cruise speed to the speed limit, switches to suitable lanes, and assists with
entering and exiting
ramps.
column5:
高速领航功能（Navigation on ZEEKR Pilot，以下简称NZP）
适用于在高精度地图覆盖的封闭城市快速路和高速公路（以适
用法律法规允许且ZEEKR极氪开通的区域为准），用户可以通
过连续向下拨动两次换挡拨杆以开启此功能；此功能可以辅助
驾驶员控制车辆沿设定的导航路线行驶、根据道路限速值自动
的调整巡航车速、智能切换至合适的车道、辅助驾驶员进出匝
道等。

column4:
With NZP on, when a large vehicle is in an adjacent lane, the system shifts the car within
its lane away from it. When obstacles such as traffic cones are detected ahead in the lane,
the system slows appropriately and plans an avoidance path, either going around the obstacle
within the lane or changing lanes to pass it.
column5:
开启NZP后，当相邻车道有大型车辆时，系统将控制车辆在车
道内反方向偏移，以远离大车。当检测到本车道前方有锥桶等
障碍物时，系统会适当减速且智能规划避障路径，包括在本车
道内绕行该障碍物和通过变道的方式绕行该障碍物。

column4:
With NZP on, NZP selects suitable lanes along the navigation route, takes on and off ramps
automatically, and overtakes when the vehicle ahead is slow. The driver can also turn on
a turn signal and the system will assist with a lane change in that direction; the signal
turns off automatically once the lane change is complete.
column5:
开启NZP后，NZP可根据导航路径选择适宜车道行驶，并控制
车辆自主上下匝道，在检测到前方车辆车速较慢时可自主变道
超车。驾驶员也可通过开启一侧转向灯，系统将辅助驾驶员进
行对应方向的变道，变道成功后转向灯会自动关闭。

column4:
Following the navigation route, NZP helps you at the right moment, by adjusting speed
and changing lanes, to automatically exit the main road onto ramps and merge from ramps into
the main road. In heavy traffic, if the system cannot complete a lane change, it will ask
for your help; be ready to take over the vehicle promptly.
column5:
NZP可以根据导航路径，辅助用户在合适的时机，通过适当的
调整车速及变换车道，自动完成从主路驶入匝道及匝道汇入主
路的动作。如果在拥堵路段，系统无法完成主动换道，系统会
向用户寻求帮助，用户需要注意及时接管车辆。

column4: Dear Customer:\nBefore using AI driving assist and/or NZP and other related functions (collectively, the "Related Functions"), please read the following carefully:\nThe Related Functions are driver assistance functions intended to improve driving convenience and comfort; they do not make the vehicle self-driving. When using the Related Functions, the driver must stay attentive at all times, ensure the safety of the vehicle and its surroundings, and keep hands on the steering wheel so as to be able to take over or take corrective action at any time. Do not rely entirely on the Related Functions to drive. The Related Functions are mainly designed for specific scenarios such as highways and elevated roads, and require roads with median barriers and clear lane markings, as well as other necessary operating conditions. In the presence of pedestrians, construction zones, bad weather, or other conditions.
